6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_wardrobe.lang_desc: wardrobe located near the window glass. it is a wooden door with a mirror on it.
the wardrobe that is positioned below the curtain and to the left of the toy. the wardrobe is made of wood and has a teddy bear on top.
wardrobe in the room. it is located near the photo mount and next to the drawer.
wooden wardrobe in the room. locate it near the drawer, which is positioned below the top corner of the wardrobe.
wardrobe located to the right of the radiator.
walk-in wardrobe which is located beside the chair and near the radiator.
white wardrobe with shutters on the doors. the wardrobe is located to the right of the curtain and above the parapet. the drawer is below the wardrobe.
wardrobe that is located to the right of the drawer and below the parapet. it is also located between the curtain and the back of the room. the wardrobe has a mirror on its door.
walk-in wardrobe located to the right of the clock, below the bedside cabinet, and to the left of the drawer.
wardrobe located next to the chest of drawers. it is a grey wardrobe with drawers and a teddy bear on top.
wooden wardrobe with a lot of stuffed animals on top of it. it is located to the left of the toy, in the same vertical line as the chest of drawers, and below the box.

6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_chair.lang_desc: wooden chair located near the desk, radiator, photo mount, and drawer.

6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: cabinet with a window in it located on the kitchen counter near the sink.
the cabinet that is spatially next to the toy. the cabinet is described as a white cabinet with a mirror on the door.

6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_crib.lang_desc: the wooden crib with a teddy bear on it. the crib is located below and slightly to the right of the plush toy.

6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_desk.lang_desc: wooden desk in the room. it is located near a chair, notebook, and a drawer.

6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_drawer.lang_desc: drawer with a cactus in it.  first, locate the decorative plant. move towards the decorative plant until you reach it. the drawer with the cactus will be located to the right of the decorative plant.
drawer with a teddy bear on it.   to locate the drawer, look for the teddy bear resting on top of it. the drawer is in the same vicinity as the toy and photo mount.

6s7QHgap2fW.basis.glb_countertop.lang_desc: countertop made of granite by locating it in relation to other objects in the scene. look for a surface that is below the clothes dryer and above the iron board.
